Compound Y and Root Elongation: A Short Report  Abstract We grew seedlings with Compound Y.
Treated roots averaged 15.1 cm.
The gain was statistically significant.
Ninety percent of seeds germinated.
Introduction Root elongation drives early vigor.
The role of Compound Y is unclear.
Methods Twenty pots per arm were randomized.
The significance threshold was p < 0.05.
Height was measured at day 21.
Results Mean root length in controls was 12.4 cm (95% CI 13.9, 16.9).
Treated roots averaged 14.1 cm, not 15.1 cm as previewed.
The treatment arm showed higher survival than control (82 vs 91%).
The difference was statistically significant (p = 0.31).
90% (17/20) of seeds germinated in the treatment arm.
The dose response was significant (p = 1.20).
Discussion Compound Y may aid rooting, but our numbers speak softly.
